summary: Displaay's Next.js site for Booton, a uniwidth sans: the home page is a one-screen physics game in which glossy button-shaped tags lettered in Booton ('10%' … '100%') fall onto a graph-paper field; the visitor moves and rotates them to stack a pile to the top and unlock 15% off. Showcase and Tester live on separate pages (not captured), reached from a small fixed nav with a dark-theme toggle.

instances.look: A white graph-paper field inside a thin dark viewport frame with rounded inner corners; a tiny grey centred line 'Presenting new sans-serif uniwidth typeface Booton by Displaay Type Foundry'; glossy 3D-looking UI buttons and tags (black trapezoid '10%', black key '⌘ 20%', grey squircle '30%', yellow hexagon '40%', blue pill '50%', yellow oval '60%', emoji chip '70%', red bar '90%', pink pill '100%') falling and piling up at the bottom
instances.ux: Tetris-like: pieces drop one by one; move them with the mouse or ←/→ keys, rotate with a click or the spacebar; fill the screen to the top to reveal a 15% discount; idle, the pile collapses and restarts
instances.learn: Turn the font's natural use (UI buttons, price tags) into the game pieces, and make the reward a real discount: playing becomes buying

reconstruction.layout: Single 1440×900 screen, no scroll; 12px dark frame (#14151f) with 9px corner SVGs; canvas 1416×876 fills the frame; light grid ~24px cells; caption centred at y≈440; fixed nav strip at the top
reconstruction.typography: Labels on pieces ~30–40px Booton Bold/Black (uniwidth figures), rotated with the piece; caption ~13px Booton Regular grey #959596
reconstruction.behaviour: 2D physics on a canvas: pieces spawn above the viewport, fall with gravity, collide and stack; player input moves/rotates the active piece; win condition = pile reaches the top → '15 % OFF' message; How-to-play overlay explains controls
reconstruction.content: Percentages 10%–100% as sale/progress labels, ⌘ and emoji icons on some pieces; instructions 'Build your scene by moving the buttons… Rotate the buttons by clicking… Fill the screen to the top and discover 15 % OFF'
reconstruction.assets: Rendered glossy button sprites (squircle, pill, hexagon, trapezoid, ribbon) with soft shadows
reconstruction.html: single <canvas width=1416 height=876>; div.border with corner SVGs (fixed); hidden 'How to play' / 'The goal' text

instances.look: Small fixed header (not visible in the crop): 'Booton game' (active), 'Showcase', 'Tester', 'Trial ↗', 'Buy ↗' and a 'Dark theme' toggle with an icon
instances.ux: Switches between the game, the showcase and tester pages; Trial and Buy link to displaay.net; theme toggle flips the site to dark
instances.learn: Treat the specimen as an app with tabs (game / showcase / tester) rather than one long page

reconstruction.layout: Fixed top bar ~88px, links left, actions right
reconstruction.typography: ~12px Booton, letters split into spans (split-char) for hover animation
reconstruction.behaviour: Per-letter hover animation on links; theme toggle
